intelligence.human_view: Think of the old calendar as a desk with a calendar on it and a pile of buttons next to it — you had to look at everything at once, and nothing felt like the calendar itself. Shawn swept the desk clean. Now the whole desk IS the calendar: the full month fills the whole screen, and nothing else is on it. You tap a date and the whole screen becomes that day — its menu, its world, its timeline — and when you tap back, you're back at the month, exactly where you were. Each day is a little black jewel, its rim lit in that day's own color, the number in beautiful colors, the wisdom of the day inside it, and a button that says VIEW. Today glows brighter than the rest, because today is alive. And the calendar runs both ways: backwards, to any day you ever lived, and forwards — someone comes and books a time with you. When you go inside a day, it doesn't scatter into doors; it becomes the story of that day, everything that happened, in time order, like a journal.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your whole screen is just the calendar! Big squares for every day, 1 to 30, nothing else! Each day is a shiny black jewel with its edges lit up in its own color. Inside each jewel: the big number, a wise little quote, and a button that says VIEW! You tap a day and BOOM — the whole screen becomes that day! You can go BACK to any day, or FORWARD — someone can even book a time with you! TODAY always glows the brightest, like it is switched on! Tell Naya ten things about you, and POOF — your About page and your Skills page are already made!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine the whole screen is just the calendar, dear — the full month, big beautiful squares for every day, and nothing else on the page at all! Each day is a lovely black jewel, dear, lit around the edges in its own color, with the number, a wise quote for that day, and a button that says VIEW! You tap a day and the whole screen becomes that day, love — everything going on, all in one place, like a journal! And you can go back to any day, dear, or forward — someone can come and book an appointment with you! Today always glows brighter than the rest, love, always switched on!
intelligence.naya_view: The whole page IS the calendar: full month, squares 1–30/31, nothing else on it. No buttons on the same page as the calendar; the menu comes only when they click a date, as a new full view — 8 doors + Book/Meet/Create + 3 cards. Harvest Shawn's prototype verbatim as the base. Vertical slice first, then verified booking, then verified Meet. Cells from his screenshot: black square, rim lit in the day's color, number + wisdom + VIEW. Grid fits the screen exactly; the ribbon goes; the day is the ONLY door; the click IS the interaction. Pricing feel: cells light up and MOVE under the touch; day numbers the Dashboard's digit tiles in the DEEP palette; TODAY glows brighter, always activated. Inside each day: a timeline, everything that went on in time order, like a journal. Ten answers in at sign-up, About + Skills out, unfolding AND slideshow, automatically. The double-up is a hair — feel the depth, never see the gap. The bottom-bar orbit stays EXACTLY as it is — approved by his eye, locked. The DNA is the root — it changes nothing, it confirms everything.
